description: Opt-in, fail-open observer for bounded skill-evolution failure fingerprints.

hooks.command:
if [ "${SKILL_EVOLUTION_HOOKS_ENABLED:-0}" != "1" ]; then exit 0; fi
observer="${HOME}/.agents/skills/skill-evolution/scripts/observe_hook.py"
if [ -f "$observer" ]; then SKILL_EVOLUTION_HARNESS=codex exec python3 "$observer"; fi
exit 0
